name: Laboratory Plane Mirror & Laws of Reflection
semanticDescription: Laboratory swivel plane mirror mounted in a brass frame with tightening knobs on vertical stanchions and studio slate plinth with leveling screws. Paired with an optical ray reflection demonstration illustrating the laws of reflection (angle i = angle r), normal line NN', virtual ray extensions, and virtual/erect image formation with lateral inversion for CBSE Class 10 optics.
